records.title: D1 and R3K minute model first conclusion
records.label_evidence: Frozen V1 label builder defines log(exit_open/entry_open), entry at anchor open and exit at anchor+h. Protocol horizons are 5/15/30 minutes with primary 15m; maturity is exit plus 1 second, and runner_v3 includes a row only when maturity is strictly before sealed/cutoff. Applies to the frozen D1/R3K arm only.
research_notes: V1 label is log(exit_open/entry_open) at anchor+h; v2 primary horizon is 15m from {5,15,30}, maturity adds one second, and runner_v3 requires maturity strictly before cutoff. Frozen Standardizer uses sampled-train column mean/std (ddof=0), maps zero std to 1, rejects nonfinite or wholly unobserved columns without imputation; SampleScalers share the anchor transform by column; TargetScaler is per horizon on sampled-train target mean/std and blocks zero/nonfinite std without epsilon. Direction z=(d*r-d*mu)/sigma; inverse d*mu+sigma*z is applied once. Numeric saved scaler values and checkpoint-to-output binding remain separate unknowns.

known.claim: D1 arm contract selects the price information family; the cited code defines the exact V1 anchor columns.
D1 arm contract selects the IV information family; V1 code names its ten derived IV columns. Raw input mapping/unit/clock remain separate unknowns.
Transformer D1 also consumes its frozen 90x7 completed-minute sequence channel tensor, defined by V1 feature code.
D1 arm is price_iv_btc_state and consumes three-state one-hot UP/DOWN/SIDEWAYS; the separate nine continuous BTC-daily fields belong to another arm and are not attributed to D1.
